purpose: Acquire versioned BRP 2025 silage-maize geometry and a versioned BRO SGM soil map for a reproducible maize-by-CCNL6 spatial crosswalk.

inputs.version_requirement: Persist exact downloaded model/version metadata and SHA-256 before transformation.

mapping_contract.historical_boundary: BRO SGM is a current/versioned spatial model; it is not identical to the historical LSK profile-domain basis used for the 2018 CC-NL area estimates.
mapping_contract.proposal_policy: AUTO_PROPOSAL_IS_NOT_ADMISSION; all used soil_unit_code mappings must still be explicitly QUALIFIED

output_contract.admission_rule: No crosswalk is admitted unless mapping coverage is complete, geometry closure is within declared tolerance, provenance hashes are persisted, and the BRO-to-CCNL6 mapping has been independently reviewed.

current_blockers: Raw BRP/BRO files are not materialized in the repository.
BRO soil_unit_code to CCNL6 mapping has zero qualified rows; official-legend family rules can generate review proposals but not admissions.
A current crop-soil crosswalk remains a spatial approximation to the six CC-NL reporting domains, not a reconstruction of historical LSK domain membership.
workflow: Materialize and hash source-native BRP 2025 and BRO SGM inputs.
Run build_onsite_maize_soil_crosswalk.py. A first run is expected to fail closed while emitting the exact intersecting missing/unqualified BRO soil-unit-code report.
Run propose_bro_ccnl6_mapping.py on that diagnostic to generate official-legend-based candidate mappings.
Review every proposal. Ambiguous families remain REVIEW_REQUIRED; AUTO_PROPOSAL never becomes QUALIFIED automatically.
Rerun the overlay. Proceed only when all intersecting mappings are QUALIFIED and area closure passes.
Compare the total with independent national crop context without proportional rescaling.
Qualify/admit the resulting crop-by-soil shares before binding them into the on-site calculation surface.
